title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does in His First 90 Days at a New Job
caption:
The first 90 days at a job set the reputation you'll carry for years.

A godly man doesn't try to impress anyone. He shows up early, learns names, asks questions, takes the hard task, and works like the Lord is his real boss. Because He is.

Save this for your next first day, or send it to a friend starting one.
